items.event: UEFA Nations League A3: Spain vs England (Madrid)
items.line: This match decides Group A3. Both teams are already through to the quarter-finals. Spain lead by three points with five wins from five, so England need a win of any margin to finish top. Tuchel called it 'winner takes it all', and Spain are unbeaten in a record 43 matches.

items.event: ATP Finals, Turin, Day 1: Shelton vs Fils (McEnroe Group)
items.line: World No. 1 Zverev opened the ATP Finals by beating debutant Rafael Jodar 6-4 6-4. No. 3 seed Ben Shelton now plays the event debutant Arthur Fils in the night session. Sinner is missing this year with a knee injury.

items.event: ATP Finals, Ivan Lendl Group: Alcaraz vs Tiafoe, then Medvedev vs Cobolli
items.line: No. 2 seed Carlos Alcaraz, chasing his first Turin title without Sinner in the field, opens against Frances Tiafoe at 22:00 JST Monday. Medvedev vs Cobolli follows at 04:30 JST Tuesday. The final is on Sunday Nov 22.

items.event: UEFA Nations League A2: Germany vs Netherlands (Berlin)
items.line: Group A2 is decided in this match. The Netherlands top the group, three points ahead of Klopp's Germany, and a draw would give them first place. A German win would lift them into top spot.

items.event: DP World Tour Championship, Dubai: Hatton wins, McIlroy takes Race to Dubai
items.line: Tyrrell Hatton closed with a 66 to win by five shots at 15 under. Runner-up Rory McIlroy held off Eugenio Chacarra (T3) to win a fifth straight Race to Dubai title, his eighth in all, equalling Colin Montgomerie's record.
